entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Counsel for Respondent :- G.A.
Hon'ble Siddhartha Varma,J.
Hon'ble Ram Manohar Narayan Mishra,J.
1.
Heard learned counsel for the petitioner and learned Aga for the State.

2.  Although, the prayer made in this writ petition is to quash the First Information Report dated 29.6.2024 giving rise to Case Crime No.185 of 2024, under Sections 420, 406, 323, 506 of Indian Penal Code, Police Station - Mugalpura, District - Moradabad, but at the time when the matter is taken up learned counsel for the petitioner confines his relief to grant of protection under section 41-A of Code of Criminal Procedure.

entities.text: Mohd Navi vs State Of Up And 2 Others
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
We have perused the the First Information Report, which prima facie discloses commissioning of cognizable offence and, therefore, the prayer made to quash F.I.R. otherwise cannot be entertained in view of the law laid down by the Supreme Court in the case of State of Telangana Vs. Habib Abdullah Jellani, (2017) 2 SCC 779 and Neeharika Infrastructure Pvt. Ltd. vs. State of Maharashtra and Others, (2021) SCC Online SC 315.
4.

entities.text: State of Telangana Vs. Habib Abdullah Jellani, (2017) 2 SCC 779
entities.label: PRECEDENT

entities.text: Neeharika Infrastructure Pvt. Ltd. vs. State of Maharashtra and Others, (2021) SCC Online SC 315
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: We are of the view that no interference is warranted.

5. However, considering the fact that all offences mentioned in the present case are punishable with a term up to 7 years, the authorities are directed to ensure the procedure of arrest as per the guidelines of the Supreme Court enshrined in the case of Arnesh Kumar vs. State of Bihar reported in (2014) 8 SCC 273.
6.

entities.text: Arnesh Kumar vs. State of Bihar reported in (2014) 8 SCC 273
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: The writ petition, accordingly, is disposed of.
